text: Requisitos de admisiónaccuracy Citizens of countries other than China Fluent in English for courses taught in English Bachelor’s Degree: i. Senior high school graduates, or those with an equivalent degree or above; ii. Sufficient background in chemistry is required for Chinese Materia Medica. Notes: *Overseas Chinese applicants applying to a bachelor’s programme must have held foreign citizenship for at least 4 years and resided in that foreign country for at least 2 years during that period (a continuous stay of 9 months counts as one year, subject to the official stamp) within the most recent 4 years (until April 30 of the year). *Applicants under 18 years of age must have their guardians’ authorisation notarised in Tianjin.
